directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The hose run is 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, output 4 m³/h. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Double-cylinder plunger mortar spraying machine at 380 V, all-copper dual motors 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg. Do not move the same condition onto German type mortar spraying machine, which prints 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 40 m horizontal / 20 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤5 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 650 × 800 mm and 360 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
